scripts.check: astro check && npm run check:content && npm run check:examples
scripts.check:examples: python3 -c 'import ast,pathlib; [ast.parse(p.read_text(encoding="utf-8"), filename=str(p)) for p in pathlib.Path("examples").rglob("*.py")]' && find examples -name '*.mjs' -print0 | xargs -0 -n1 node --check && find examples -name '*.sh' -print0 | xargs -0 -n1 bash -n
scripts.build:search: npm run build:search:en && npm run build:search:vi
scripts.build: npm run check:content && npm run check:examples && npm run build:astro && npm run build:search && npm run check:site
